journey.title: Triage experience debt
journey.purpose: An operator goes from 'where is the fleet worst?' to concrete claim evidence in three navigations.

steps.intent: Spot the worst scenario at the top of the debt table without searching for it.
See which of that scenario's pages and states are weakest, and which claims are failing.
Inspect the failing claim's capture and the accessibility-tree node behind the verdict.

claims.statement: Concrete evidence is reachable from the fleet landing in at most three navigations, with no dead ends.
claims.rationale: Runtime journey checking is P2 (OT-P2-002), built on workflow-health execution.
